note: Pre-declared #59 acceptance set. It records exact local fixtures and the two explicitly allowed public sources; it never treats a reachable URL, a found PDF or an item count as proof of a complete menu. BE-21's wider vendor/OCR benchmark is out of scope.

schemaVersions.productMapping: existing receipt + concept contract; a lossless extension is design-only in planning/architecture/menu-extraction-product-schema-v2.md

requiredClasses.html: Static HTML headings, lists and repeated dish blocks.
requiredClasses.accordion_tabs: Tab/accordion panels whose DOM relation decides the menu variant and section.
requiredClasses.tables: Table rows and definition lists, including a price without a name.
requiredClasses.text_pdf: Digital text PDF, columns, baselines, multiple pages and price variants.
requiredClasses.scan_unreadable: Scan/image-only, encrypted or otherwise unreadable PDF; the product must report the limit, not OCR it.
requiredClasses.language_branch: Non-Dutch menu labels and a chain/location menu that must not be assigned to another branch.
requiredClasses.arrangement: Arrangement, choice menu, supplement or per-person price, kept out of ordinary dishes.
requiredClasses.price_variant: Glass/bottle, from-price or multiple undecomposed prices; never silently choose one.
requiredClasses.historical_cards: Existing Wolfslaar, Bardot, Zuyd and T-Huis snapshots as a shape regression, never current truth.
requiredClasses.safety_and_errors: Timeout, provider failure, invalid output, budget/page limits, reimport, concurrency, prompt injection, wrong branch and unsafe redirect.
requiredClasses.contract_mapping: One validated result reaching receipt, review, concept and export without silent flattening.
requiredClasses.review_surface: Shared uncertainty is reviewable per group; no accept-all action; duplicate and price blockers stay separate.
requiredClasses.browser_fixture: Existing import/review UI in an isolated local browser fixture; explicitly not live integration.

releaseThresholds.manualCorrectionTime: unknown; not measured in this round and never reported as zero
releaseThresholds.costPerSourceEurCents: unknown; no provider was called and unknown cost is never reported as 0

representative.sourceVersion: offline fake provider and .invalid HTTP fixtures
expected: Timeout, provider exception, invalid output, missing budget, input/output/page limits and async guards all refuse before or after a call with a concrete reason.
Reimport is idempotent, concurrent claims cannot double-process, and source text cannot inject instructions or trust fields.
A wrong branch or unsafe redirect is rejected by the existing safe-fetch/host rules.
representative.result: The targeted suites pass offline; no real provider or network call is involved.
limitations: Provider failure is simulated, not observed; no real provider is configured or approved.

expected: Summary, detail, review and concept all read the same validated extraction result.
Variant, order, source id, quote and uncertainty survive mapping; unsupported fields are blocked/reported, not flattened.
Concept preview and export use the same generated menu entry; no automatic publication.
representative.result: All mapped fields and the STRUCT-017 concept/export equality pass; unsupported variants/supplements/allergens are reported.
limitations: The receipt/concept contract has one price per line; the lossless v2 design is not implemented.

expected: Only the uncertain group is accepted by its own action; duplicate and missing-price blockers remain.
A legacy accept cannot settle a duplicate, and the server re-checks every blocker.
Attention groups are per variant + section, never one flattened global list.
representative.result: The group/duplicate/price separation regressions pass in the full suite.
limitations: Component-level logic only until the isolated browser fixture below is executed.

representative.sourceVersion: fictional .invalid restaurant and batch fixture; no production credentials or data
expected: Exact links, section labels, prices, duplicate/price blockers and grouped uncertainty are visible in the existing import/review UI.
Empty, partial and error states are reachable and honest.
Keyboard navigation, light/dark and 320/390 px have no horizontal overflow and keep the same content.
representative.result: 72/72 fixture checks pass on Edge 155 at 1024/390/320 px in light and dark: exact links, section paths, prices, duplicate/price/missing-price blockers, grouped uncertainty, disabled save, empty/partial/error, keyboard Enter activation and zero horizontal overflow. 10 screenshots hashed.
limitations: Fixture evidence only; it is not live integration, staging or production acceptance.
Reaching the review control from the top of the page took 43 Tab stops; no focus trap was found.
The fictional session/API is intercepted in the page; no production Supabase project or credential is used.

holdout.rule: A holdout entry is executed at most once per pinned source version and is never adjusted after seeing its result. Once an entry is used to change extraction it moves to the representative set and a new holdout entry is required. Smelt and Blossem have already been used for tuning and can never be presented as unseen holdout.
